title: AttendIQ - Smart Attendance
description: Hackathon-winning (1st place) smart attendance & student engagement system for Bhagwan Mahavir University. Combines Face AI identity verification and campus location checks with engagement analytics, explainable academic-risk rules and AI recommendations across Admin, Teacher and Student portals.
challenges: Building a single source of truth that marks attendance only after both face identity and campus-radius location are verified, then turning raw records into weighted engagement signals and explainable risk flags.

title: Seliora FreeLance
description: A premium fullstack freelance platform built to connect clients and developers. Implements Razorpay payment gateway integration, Cloudinary media storage, and a robust admin panel.
challenges: Integrating complex webhook workflows for Razorpay payment confirmations, configuring responsive image uploads and processing via Cloudinary, and setting up clean multi-tenant role permissions in Next.js App Router.

title: Food Delivery App
description: MERN Stack food delivery application with cart management, user authentication, restaurant browsing, and an interactive admin dashboard for order tracking and inventory.
challenges: Designing real-time status updates for orders, securing user endpoints with JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and syncing cart operations across multiple sessions and page reloads.

title: Jadoo - Travels Website
description: Modern and responsive Tours & Travels landing platform designed to explore exotic destinations, tour packages, and travel deals. Features smooth scroll navigation and interactive UI elements.
challenges: Structuring dynamic JSON loaders for destination details and achieving high performance loading times and responsive layouts across all mobile screen viewports.
